record: Sabah Tourism Board on the City Mosque
facts: This is the City Mosque beside Likas Bay, partly surrounded by a man-made lagoon, with a design inspired by the Nabawi Mosque.

record: Tourism Malaysia description of the Kota Kinabalu floating mosque
facts: The mosque at Jalan Teluk Likas is known for the large surrounding artificial lagoon.

record: Abdullatif Al Fozan Award architecture record
facts: The Akitek Bersatu project opened in 2000. Four round minarets rise from square bases over three levels of balconies, and a checked blue dome stands above the main hall.
